topography.project_purpose: Liquid Staking. Structurally: 49 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 10 ERC20 tokens, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 24 common project-authored base contract(s) (ethvault, vaultimmutables, vaultadmin). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
